skill.covenant.piercing_shot.description: Stalker: fire a bow arrow with 50% increased base damage at one target. Requires a bow and arrow.
skill.covenant.cleave.description: Reaver: hit nearby non-allied living targets within 3 blocks and line of sight for your melee attack damage.
skill.covenant.arcane_bolt.description: Weaver: cast a straight magical projectile dealing 6 damage to one target.

class.covenant.stalker.description: Precise ranged combat with bows and other ranged weapons, dealing damage while keeping enemies at a distance.
class.covenant.reaver.description: Dedicated close-quarters combat with swords, axes, and other melee weapons, dealing damage through direct combat.
class.covenant.weaver.description: Elemental spellcaster intended for simple offensive magic and magical equipment where supported. Elemental skills are not yet implemented.
commands.covenant.class.usage: Choose once with /covenant class select <id>. Class choice does not restrict equipment.
commands.covenant.class.already_selected: Your character already has a class. Class reselection is not available.
commands.covenant.stats.set: %s temporary base set to %s; effective value: %s. Unsaved; clear with /covenant stats reset.
commands.covenant.stats.reset: Cleared %s temporary stat override(s). Normal calculations restored.
commands.covenant.stats.unknown: Unsupported stat: %s. Use /covenant stats or tab completion for supported identifiers.
commands.covenant.stats.invalid_value: Invalid base for %s: enter a finite number from %s to %s (inclusive).
commands.covenant.affix.empty_hand: Hold an item in your main hand first.
commands.covenant.affix.stacked: Affix Pages require exactly one item. Split the stack before applying.
commands.covenant.affix.already_paged: This item already has an Affix Page. Remove or clear it before applying a new one.
commands.covenant.affix.invalid_value: Invalid modifier amount: enter a finite number. Negative amounts are allowed; effective stats retain their normal limits.
commands.covenant.affix.unknown_category: Unsupported category: %s. Tab completion lists loaded Affix Page compatibility categories.
commands.covenant.affix.incompatible: The held item is not compatible with category %s.
commands.covenant.affix.unknown_stat: Unsupported test stat: %s. Use tab completion for supported stat identifiers.
commands.covenant.affix.no_page: The held item has no Affix Page.
commands.covenant.affix.applied: Attached test page: category %s, %s add %s. Bonuses apply in the category's supported equipment slot after the normal equipment update.
commands.covenant.affix.removed: Cleared the held item's complete Affix Page. Other item data and its current stack limit are unchanged.
skill.covenant.disengage.description: leap backward relative to the direction the player is facing.
skill.covenant.bear_trap.description: throw a single-use trap a short distance in front of the player.
skill.covenant.aimed_shot.description: a short wind-up followed by one stronger, single-target arrow.
skill.covenant.barrage.description: fire a rapid sequence of arrows while the skill keybind is held and sufficient Focus remains.
skill.covenant.snipe.description: charge while standing still, then fire one single-target shot.
skill.covenant.dodge_aura.description: Passive: increase dodge chance while the aura is assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.frost_trap.description: when triggered, create a temporary frost patch that slows enemies only while they are inside it.
skill.covenant.arcane_arrow.description: fire a single-target arrow that deals magic damage and briefly increases the target's damage taken from everyone, including teammates.
skill.covenant.poison_shot.description: fire a single-target arrow that deals initial hit damage and then applies poison damage over time.
skill.covenant.multishot.description: fire several arrows simultaneously in a horizontal fan, covering enemies spread across the player's view.
skill.covenant.flame_trap.description: when triggered, create a temporary burning area that repeatedly damages enemies inside it.
skill.covenant.swiftness_aura.descriptio: Passive: increase movement speed while the aura is assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.snaring_shot.description: fire a shot that applies poison damage over time plus a strong temporary movement slow.
skill.covenant.blast_trap.description: when triggered, produce one TNT-like explosion that damages nearby enemies and knocks them away without destroying blocks.
skill.covenant.meteor_arrow.description: a spell with a cast time that uses an instant-shot arrow to designate whatever it connects with as the target of a meteor.
skill.covenant.ballista.description: deploy a temporary stationary turret that automatically fires heavy bolts at nearby enemies.
skill.covenant.volley.description: rain arrows vertically across a broad spread over the chosen ground area.
skill.covenant.rend.description: a single-target melee strike that deals an initial hit and applies bleeding damage over time.
skill.covenant.battle_cry.description: an active shout that briefly increases all outgoing damage for the player and nearby allies, including spells and damage over time.
skill.covenant.rage_storm.description: a spell-like cast with a wind-up, followed by an area of effect released from the player that slowly moves forward.
skill.covenant.execute.description: a heavy single-target melee attack usable only when the enemy is below a health threshold.
skill.covenant.blood_fever.description: grant the player movement-speed and attack-speed bonuses based on the number of nearby bleeding enemies.
skill.covenant.leap.description: leap toward a ground point the player aims at, dealing area damage on landing.
skill.covenant.ripping_aura.description: Passive: increase bleed damage while the aura is assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.fortitude_aura.descriptio: Passive: increase armor and armor toughness while the aura is assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.bloody_cloak.description: a temporary self-buff that heals the player for a portion of the bleed damage they deal.
skill.covenant.overpower.description: a single-target melee hit that deals normal damage to bleeding enemies and gains a huge damage bonus against non-bleeding enemies.
skill.covenant.consume.description: an area skill that removes bleeds from affected enemies.
skill.covenant.enduring_cry.description: an active shout that briefly reduces damage taken for the player and nearby allies.
skill.covenant.skull_bash.description: a single-target melee hit that briefly stuns the enemy, preventing movement and attacks.
skill.covenant.raging_aura.description: Passive: while assigned to a skill slot, reduce the player's out-of-combat Rage decay rate after the existing grace period.
skill.covenant.war_banner.description: plant a temporary stationary banner that grants health regeneration and prevents hunger loss for the player and nearby allies within its radius.
skill.covenant.guillotine.description: remove bleeds from one target, dealing a flat damage amount per bleed instance removed, as the single-target counterpart to Consume.
skill.covenant.demon_mode.description: while this temporary mode is active, attacking teleports the player to the enemy under their crosshair, up to 5 blocks away.
skill.covenant.lightning_bolt.descriptio: once cast, strike instantly along the player's aim, stopping at the first enemy or solid block.
skill.covenant.mage_armour.description: a temporary self-buff that increases armor, armor toughness, and knockback resistance, paid for with an upfront Mana cost.
skill.covenant.arcane_barrage.descriptio: hold the skill keybind to repeatedly fire arcane missiles while sufficient Mana remains.
skill.covenant.ice_bolt.description: fire a traveling single-target projectile that deals damage and briefly slows the enemy's movement.
skill.covenant.discharge.description: store stacks from previously cast ice, fire, and lightning spells, with a separate counter capped at 5 for each element.
skill.covenant.fire_bolt.description: fire a traveling single-target projectile that deals an initial hit and ignites the enemy.
skill.covenant.icy_veins.description: Passive: reduce skill cooldowns while assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.flame_cloak.description: Passive: reduce incoming fire damage while assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.teleport.description: blink along the player's aim, stopping at a clear position before solid obstacles.
skill.covenant.freezing_aura.description: Passive: slow nearby enemies while assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.shock_aura.description: Passive: increase nearby enemies' damage taken while assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.immolation_aura.descripti: Passive: damage nearby enemies with fire while assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.threefold_system.descript: Passive: store elemental power based on other elemental types the player has used recently.
skill.covenant.ice_tomb.description: encase the player in ice, granting temporary invulnerability while preventing movement, attacks, and casting.
skill.covenant.firestorm.description: one cast starts a fixed-duration rain of fiery impacts over an aimed ground area, igniting enemies hit.
skill.covenant.weavers_web.description: place a temporary web field at an aimed location.
skill.covenant.enchanting_aura.descripti: Passive: increase Mana regeneration while assigned to a skill slot.
skill.covenant.beacon.description: mark the player's current position with a temporary beacon.
skill.covenant.elemental_golem.descripti: the golem has 4 forms: fire, ice, lightning, and arcane.
skill.covenant.arcane_explosion.descript: after a wind-up, release one large magic-damage burst centered on the player.
skill.covenant.blizzard.description: one cast starts a fixed-duration storm over an aimed area, dealing cold damage over time and slowing enemies.
skill.covenant.scorching_ray.description: hold the skill keybind to channel an aimable beam that pierces enemies but stops at solid blocks, hitting aligned enemies within its range.
screen.covenant.skills.diagram_level: Diagram level %s (no level requirement in this pass)
